segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Listen to a talk in a marketing class.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Today, we're diving into the dynamic and often unpredictable world of viral marketing.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Viral marketing is a strategy that has redefined how brands connect with audiences in the digital age.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Viral marketing, of course, harnesses the power of social networks, relying on individuals to share content that resonates, entertains, or provokes thought.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: When executed effectively, a viral campaign can generate massive exposure.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: This amplifies brand visibility at a fraction of the cost of traditional advertising methods.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: You don't need to pay for ads when the video or meme is exploding on its own.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: What makes viral marketing so compelling is its potential for exponential reach.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: A single post, video, or meme can cascade through online communities, crossing geographic and demographic boundaries in mere hours.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: But this strategy is far from foolproof.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: One of the biggest challenges is unpredictability.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: There's no guaranteed formula for virality.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: What resonates with one audience may be ignored by another.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: And content that's edgy or controversial may be more likely to go viral, but it can also spark backlash and damage a company's reputation.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Another risk is loss of control.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Once content goes viral, it's no longer in the hands of the brand.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Memes, remixes, and commentary can distort the original message, sometimes in ways that conflict with the brand's values or goals.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: But despite these risks, viral marketing remains an invaluable tool, particularly for startups and emerging brands seeking rapid traction.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: Next, let's talk about some case studies of particularly effective viral marketing campaigns.
